request.style: English, male solo voice, somber, acoustic piano, cello, low strings, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Israel marched out to meet the Philistines
They camped at Ebenezer in the dust
The battle was joined and Israel fell
Four thousand men struck down on the field

[Verse]
The elders asked why the LORD let us fall
Bring the ark from Shiloh to our camp
It came with a shout that shook the earth
The Philistines feared what they heard in the dark

[Chorus]
The glory has departed from Israel
The ark of God is captured by the foe
Hophni and Phinehas are no more
The mighty shield of our nation is gone

[Verse]
A man of Benjamin ran to the gate
His clothes were torn and dirt on his head
Eli sat by the road with trembling heart
He heard the outcry of the city's grief

[Pre-Chorus]
Eli was old and his eyes were dim
He asked the messenger what had gone wrong
The news of defeat came heavy and hard
Two sons are dead and the ark is lost

[Chorus]
The glory has departed from Israel
The ark of God is captured by the foe
Hophni and Phinehas are no more
The mighty shield of our nation is gone

[Bridge]
He fell backward off his seat by the gate
His neck was broken and he died that day
He had led Israel for forty years
But now his life was cut short and gone

[Outro]
Her son was born as her breath was leaving
She named him Ichabod in her pain
The glory has departed from Israel
The ark of God has been captured away
